# Security Review — pass2

## Summary
All three findings from pass1 have been resolved in this revision, and no new security issues were introduced by the updates to `packages/element/src/textRanges.ts`, `packages/excalidraw/data/reconcile.ts`, `packages/element/src/renderElement.ts`, or `packages/excalidraw/actions/actionProperties.tsx`. Specifically: (1) `isValidRangeColor` in `packages/element/src/textRanges.ts:19-34` now enforces a 64-character maximum and validates trimmed strings against `SAFE_CSS_COLOR_RE` (`#hex`, numeric `rgb()`/`rgba()`/`hsl()`/`hsla()`, or ASCII named colors, excluding `"transparent"` and `url(...)` paint-server references); (2) `normalizeTextRanges` (`packages/element/src/textRanges.ts:17,55-56`) and `getStyleForTextRange` (`packages/element/src/textRanges.ts:385-397`) cap processed range entries at `MAX_TEXT_RANGES = 512` and replace the `Math.max(...ranges.map(...))` spread with a bounded iterative loop; and (3) `reconcileElements` (`packages/excalidraw/data/reconcile.ts:95-119,134-152`) guards `originalText` length lookups with `typeof element.originalText === "string" ? element.originalText.length : 0` and writes back or deletes `textRanges` according to `normalizeTextRanges`.

The security re-review (`pass2`) is complete and has been written to `.sdlc/runs/20261106-152440-feature-new-text-range-styling/security_review.md`.

### Resolution of Previous Findings
1. **Finding 1 (`isValidRangeColor` SVG injection) — Closed:** `packages/element/src/textRanges.ts:19-34` now bounds trimmed color strings to 64 characters, rejects `"transparent"`, and validates values against `SAFE_CSS_COLOR_RE` (`#hex`, numeric `rgb()`/`rgba()`/`hsl()`/`hsla()`, or ASCII named colors), blocking `url(...)` paint-server references.
2. **Finding 2 (Unbounded ranges / `Math.max` spread DoS) — Closed:** `packages/element/src/textRanges.ts:17,55-56,385-397` caps range entries at `MAX_TEXT_RANGES = 512` in `normalizeTextRanges` and computes `maxEnd` iteratively with `Number.isFinite` checks in `getStyleForTextRange`.
3. **Finding 3 (`reconcileElements` `originalText` `TypeError`) — Closed:** `packages/excalidraw/data/reconcile.ts:95-127,134-152` guards `element.originalText` with `typeof element.originalText === "string" ? element.originalText.length : 0` across both remote and local reconciliation branches and strips or updates `textRanges` accordingly.

No new findings were identified in the updated files (`packages/element/src/textRanges.ts`, `packages/excalidraw/data/reconcile.ts`, `packages/element/src/renderElement.ts`, `packages/excalidraw/actions/actionProperties.tsx`).
